summary.summary: The interviewee emphasized the importance of exploring the use of tidal marsh to mitigate salinity intrusion in the Delta, especially in guiding the phasing of tidal marsh restoration programs. They highlighted the need for a better understanding of relevant salinities based on system needs and recommended exploring fresh salinity regimes and meeting higher standards to address salinity management effectively.
